workstream.detail: Reintroduce a single persistent 3D model that travels through sections driven by sceneStore.progress. Extend lib/scenePoses.ts ScenePose with pos[x,y,z], rot[x,y,z], scale per section. Create components/three/TravelerModel.tsx (drei useGLTF, lazy+Suspense) loading public/models/DamagedHelmet.glb (already present) OR download a thematic GLB (drone/robot, e.g. three.js examples RobotExpressive.glb) into public/models. Damp the model toward samplePose(progress) each frame (same pattern as the camera) + subtle idle bob/rotation. Mount it in the existing scene canvas. Pause its frameloop on the portfolio:bg-pause event when Showcase is in view. Keep low-tier/touch/reduced-motion fallback. ACCEPTANCE: screenshots at 2-3 scroll positions show the model in clearly different poses/positions per section; tsc clean; one WebGL canvas active at a time.
